answer: Each identity registers one slab at a jetty yard and locks a 70-credit bond. Its face is measured at three points, with thickness and reflection posted. A pearl inlay stamped by its key binds slab to key. An auditor remeasures them against a still oasis pool; a mismatch or reused inlay burns the bond and voids the identity. The first fee is 31, the kth 31+6(k-1), the 1000th 6025, so 1000 fakes pay 3,028,000 plus 70,000 locked. A rented ring fails because its inlay carries the owner's key. An honest agent pays 31 once and recovers the bond after a clean epoch.
